12.0.en: Her old dance [[costume:costume]] will [[fascinate:fascinate]] every child in the front row.
12.0.zh: 她那身旧舞衣会把前排的每个孩子都迷住。

12.1.en: A [[decent:decent]] clean hem looks good, and neat buttons add an [[exquisite:exquisite]] touch.
12.1.zh: 干净体面的折边很好看，齐整的纽扣更添一份精致。

12.2.en: She walks with [[gentle:gentle]] [[grace:grace]] and a [[quiet:quiet]], simple [[elegance:elegance]] every day.
12.2.zh: 她每天走路都带着温柔的优雅和安静的朴素之美。

12.3.en: Her neat new [[appearance:appearance]] needs no costly shop [[cosmetics:cosmetics]] at all.
12.3.zh: 她整洁的新模样，根本不需要店里那些昂贵的化妆品。

12.4.en: Light soft [[makeup:makeup]] keeps her looking sweet and [[charming:charming]] all day long.
12.4.zh: 淡淡的妆让她一整天都甜美迷人。

12.5.en: We [[clothe:clothe]] the child warmly and repair every torn school [[garment:garment]].
12.5.zh: 我们给孩子穿得暖暖的，补好每一件撕破的校服。

13.0.en: The freshly folded [[laundry:laundry]] fills the small [[wardrobe:wardrobe]] in her tidied bedroom once more.
13.0.zh: 刚叠好的干净衣物又把收拾过的卧室里那只小衣柜塞满了。

13.1.en: His work [[overall:overalls]] are covered in dust, so he borrows a long grey [[overcoat:overcoat]].
13.1.zh: 他的工装裤落满灰尘，只好借了一件长长的灰大衣。

13.2.en: A soft morning [[robe:robe]] and a long evening [[gown:gown]] hang behind the screen.
13.2.zh: 一件柔软的晨袍和一条长长的晚礼服挂在屏风后面。

13.3.en: I repair a blue winter [[sweater:sweater]] and a brown biking [[jacket:jacket]].
13.3.zh: 我补好一件蓝冬毛衣和一件棕色骑行夹克。

13.4.en: His grey work [[trousers:trousers]] need a strong button and a little silver [[clasp:clasp]].
13.4.zh: 他的灰工裤要钉一颗结实的纽扣，再加一个小银搭扣。

13.5.en: I shape the bent hat [[brim:brim]] and wash a soft flowered [[scarf:scarf]].
13.5.zh: 我把压弯的帽檐整好，又洗了一条柔软的碎花围巾。

14.0.en: A white dotted [[handkerchief:handkerchief]] and a small buttoned [[purse:purse]] lie side by side.
14.0.zh: 白点手帕和扣着扣的小钱包并排躺着。

14.1.en: I keep a worn brown [[wallet:wallet]] and a grey sleeveless [[vest:vest]] for daily use.
14.1.zh: 我日常用着一只旧棕钱包和一件灰色无袖背心。

14.2.en: I [[wrap:wrap]] the gift neatly and hang her dark theatre [[cloak:cloak]] inside the cupboard.
14.2.zh: 我把礼物包得整整齐齐，再把她的深色剧场斗篷挂进柜里。

14.3.en: The white shirt [[collar:collar]] is bent, and one [[sleeve:sleeve]] of the long coat is too short.
14.3.zh: 白衬衫的领子翘了，长大衣有一只袖子太短。

14.4.en: One warm winter [[sock:sock]] and a thin party [[stocking:stocking]] still wait for their matching pairs.
14.4.zh: 一只暖冬袜和一条薄派对长袜还在等各自的另一半。

14.5.en: Her pink soft [[slipper:slippers]] are worn through, yet the white [[lace:lace]] edging still looks pretty.
14.5.zh: 她的粉色软拖鞋磨穿了，白色的蕾丝边倒还挺好看。

15.0.en: The kind old [[tailor:tailor]] will [[sew:sew]] the hem before the evening show.
15.0.zh: 好心的老裁缝会在晚会开始前把折边缝好。

15.1.en: We [[spin:spin]] the yarn smoothly and add one strong hidden [[stitch:stitch]].
15.1.zh: 我们把纱线纺得匀匀的，再加一针结实的暗线。

15.2.en: My sharp chrome [[needle:needle]] flashes, and each colored [[pin:pin]] holds a pleat in place.
15.2.zh: 镀铬钢针闪闪发亮，每枚彩针都别住一道褶。

15.3.en: A long red [[string:string]] and a thin white [[thread:thread]] lie beside the roller.
15.3.zh: 长红绳和细白线并排躺在滚轮旁边。

15.4.en: A torn bag [[strap:strap]] hangs loose, while a painted wall [[stripe:stripe]] guides my cut.
15.4.zh: 破包带松松地垂着，墙上的漆条纹指引我下剪。

15.5.en: A pink satin [[ribbon:ribbon]] ties the box shut, and a black school [[belt:belt]] needs new holes.
15.5.zh: 粉缎带把盒子系紧，黑校腰带得再打几个孔。

16.0.en: A thin gold [[chain:chain]] shines beside her small new [[bracelet:bracelet]].
16.0.zh: 细金链在她崭新的小手镯旁闪着光。

16.1.en: Her old pearl [[necklace:necklace]] broke, so I renew the silk and reset every tiny fallen [[bead:bead]].
16.1.zh: 她的旧珍珠项链断了，我重新换好丝线，把每颗掉落的小珠子都归回原位。

16.2.en: The [[textile:textile]] scraps I saved and a piece of red [[velvet:velvet]] fill the little box.
16.2.zh: 我攒下的纺织碎料和一块红丝绒把小箱子装得满满的。

16.3.en: Soft grey [[wool:wool]] and a flowered knee [[patch:patch]] save the old coat.
16.3.zh: 柔软的灰羊毛和一块碎花膝部补丁救回了这件旧大衣。

16.4.en: I wipe the worktop with a torn cleaning [[rag:rag]] here in our [[shabby:shabby]] but cozy corner.
16.4.zh: 在这个破旧却温馨的小角落，我用一块破抹布擦净台面。

16.5.en: The [[tight:tight]] [[belt:belt]] is eased, and a calm deep [[purple:purple]] shade hides the repair.
16.5.zh: 勒得紧的腰带放宽了，一抹沉静的深紫盖住了修补的痕迹。

17.0.en: A soft [[tan:tan]] coat is cleaned with care, so its warm color will never [[fade:fade]].
17.0.zh: 浅棕色大衣被细心洗护，暖色调永远不会褪去。

17.1.en: Each dark food [[stain:stain]] and each paint [[blot:blot]] slowly fades from the cloth.
17.1.zh: 每一块深色食物渍、每一点颜料斑，都慢慢从布面上褪去。

17.2.en: The tall singer is quite a [[figure:figure]] on our street today, looking [[slender:slender]] in her fixed dress.
17.2.zh: 那位高个子女歌手今天真成了街上的风景，修好的裙子衬得她十分苗条。

17.3.en: At [[dusk:dusk]] we share tea, thankful for each [[slight:slight]] repair that warms our street.
17.3.zh: 黄昏时分我们共饮热茶，感谢每一处小小修补温暖了整条街。

18.0.en: Grandma announced her plan for the [[erection:erection]] of a new hall, brushing aside every past [[stricture:stricture]] about money.
18.0.zh: 奶奶宣布了新建一间厅堂的计划，不再理会过去那些关于钱的指责。

18.1.en: Mom agreed to [[construct:construct]] a warm dining hall, though old [[dust:dust]] might [[obstruct:obstruct]] or even [[ruin:ruin]] dinner.
18.1.zh: 妈妈同意建一间暖和的饭厅，尽管旧灰尘可能碍事，甚至毁了晚餐。

18.2.en: Mingming wanted to [[establish:establish]] clear duties for everyone, starting with washing the grey [[concrete:concrete]] floor.
18.2.zh: 明明想给每个人定下明确的分工，从冲洗灰色水泥地面开始。

18.3.en: Uncle Wang brought bright [[steel:steel]] tools, promising strength and long [[stability:stability]] for the shelves.
18.3.zh: 王叔带来了亮闪闪的钢制工具，保证架子结实稳固、用得长久。

18.4.en: They walked around the dusty [[site:site]], dreaming of how the future [[venue:venue]] would welcome guests.
18.4.zh: 他们绕着满是灰尘的工地走了一圈，畅想未来这里将如何迎接宾客。

18.5.en: The old house was a village [[landmark:landmark]], quietly [[situated:situated]] beside green trees and [[narrow:narrow]] paths.
18.5.zh: 老屋是村里的地标，静静坐落在绿树与窄巷之间。

19.0.en: Mom tried to [[locate:locate]] the old drawings in the corner where grandpa once chose to [[reside:reside]] and cook.
19.0.zh: 妈妈想找出旧图纸，就在爷爷当年住过、做过饭的那个角落。

19.1.en: Small birds still [[inhabit:inhabit]] the roof, but they will [[migrate:migrate]] elsewhere once the noise begins.
19.1.zh: 小鸟们还住在屋顶上，可噪声一起，它们就会迁往别处。

19.2.en: Grandma decided to [[settle:settle]] downstairs, keeping the whole [[dwelling:dwelling]] [[lively:lively]] day and [[night:night]].
19.2.zh: 奶奶决定住到楼下，让整栋屋子白天黑夜都热热闹闹。

19.3.en: Mingming joked that their home was no [[skyscraper:skyscraper]] and no rich man's [[villa:villa]], yet it was full of love.
19.3.zh: 明明打趣说，他家既不是摩天大楼，也不是富人的别墅，却满满都是爱。

19.4.en: Unlike a cold [[mansion:mansion]] or a crowded [[apartment:apartment]], this place kept childhood memories alive.
19.4.zh: 不像冷冰冰的大宅，也不像拥挤的公寓，这里一直留着童年的回忆。

19.5.en: They refused to turn it into a noisy [[hostel:hostel]] or a hunting [[lodge:lodge]] for strangers.
19.5.zh: 他们不肯把它改成吵闹的旅舍，也不愿让陌生人来当猎屋。

20.0.en: Behind the yard stood a weak [[hut:hut]] and a [[wooden:wooden]] [[cabin:cabin]] full of battered chairs.
20.0.zh: 院子后面立着一间破棚和一间木屋，里面堆满了破椅子。

20.1.en: Mom opened the dark [[cellar:cellar]] and the leaning [[shed:shed]], coughing through the thick [[dust:dust]].
20.1.zh: 妈妈打开黑洞洞的地窖和歪斜的棚屋，呛得直咳嗽。

20.2.en: The little [[cottage:cottage]] next door once served as a daytime [[nursery:nursery]] for village children.
20.2.zh: 隔壁的小村舍白天曾是村里孩子的托儿所。

20.3.en: Mingming found his tiny [[cradle:cradle]] there, now a safe [[shelter:shelter]] for the kittens.
20.3.zh: 明明在那里找到了自己小时候的摇篮，如今成了小猫安稳的窝。

20.4.en: Uncle Wang moved each fallen [[block:block]], then drew a neat [[grid:grid]] on [[paper:paper]] for the cleaning plan.
20.4.zh: 王叔搬开每一块掉落的砌块，又在纸上画出整齐的方格来安排清扫。

20.5.en: They swept a [[narrow:narrow]] [[aisle:aisle]] [[first:first]], then cleared the leaves off the wide [[porch:porch]].
20.5.zh: 他们先扫出一条窄过道，再清掉宽门廊上的落叶。

21.0.en: [[dust:Dust]] covered the long [[corridor:corridor]], and [[spider:spider]] webs hung along the shaky [[staircase:staircase]].
21.0.zh: 长走廊蒙着灰尘，摇晃的楼梯旁挂满了蜘蛛网。

21.1.en: The upper [[storey:storey]] held a thick [[layer:layer]] of [[ash:ash]] that made everyone sneeze loudly.
21.1.zh: 楼上那层积着厚厚的灰，呛得大家连声打喷嚏。

21.2.en: Mingming joked that the old house had no [[escalator:escalator]], gripping the loose [[wooden:wooden]] [[handrail:handrail]] tightly.
21.2.zh: 明明紧抓着松动的木扶手，打趣说这老房子可没有自动扶梯。

21.3.en: Grandma wiped one stone [[pillar:pillar]] after another, counting each tall [[column:column]] aloud.
21.3.zh: 奶奶把石柱一根根擦过去，还大声数着每根高柱。

21.4.en: A cracked [[wooden:wooden]] [[beam:beam]] held up the curved [[vault:vault]] above the main hall.
21.4.zh: 一根裂了缝的木梁撑着正厅上方弯弯的穹顶。

21.5.en: Mom praised the [[round:round]] [[arch:arch]] and the high [[ceiling:ceiling]] that kept the summer air cool.
21.5.zh: 妈妈夸那道圆拱和高高的天花板让夏日屋内凉爽。

22.0.en: Sparrows nested under the wide [[eaves:eaves]], near the tall stone [[chimney:chimney]] full of soot.
22.0.zh: 麻雀在宽宽的屋檐下筑巢，挨着积满烟灰的高高石烟囱。

22.1.en: They planned a simple [[reception:reception]] corner, brighter than any hotel [[lobby:lobby]] in town.
22.1.zh: 他们打算布置一个简单的迎客角，要比镇上任何旅馆大堂都亮堂。

22.2.en: With the rickety [[wooden:wooden]] [[bench:bench]] gone, the old [[parlour:parlour]] looked empty and sad.
22.2.zh: 摇晃的木长凳搬走后，旧客厅显得空荡荡的，有点冷清。

22.3.en: Grandma kept the stone [[fireplace:fireplace]] but removed the rusty [[iron:iron]] [[radiator:radiator]] beside it.
22.3.zh: 奶奶留下了石头壁炉，却搬走了旁边生锈的铁暖气片。

22.4.en: Mingming cleaned the dusty [[living room:living room]] shelves, polishing every [[wooden:wooden]] [[cabinet:cabinet]] door.
22.4.zh: 明明擦净客厅里落灰的架子，把每扇木柜门都擦得发亮。

23.0.en: Mom opened the sunny [[balcony:balcony]] doors and swept dry leaves off the stone [[terrace:terrace]].
23.0.zh: 妈妈推开朝阳的阳台门，扫掉石头露台上的枯叶。

23.1.en: The old [[kitchen:kitchen]] smelled of smoke, worse even than the forgotten back [[lavatory:lavatory]].
23.1.zh: 旧厨房满是烟味，比后面那间被遗忘的盥洗室还难闻。

23.2.en: Uncle Wang scrubbed the yellowed [[toilet:toilet]] seat, then wiped the stained edge of the [[bath:bath]] [[tub:tub]].
23.2.zh: 王叔刷洗发黄的马桶座圈，又擦掉浴缸边沿的污渍。

23.3.en: Unlike the noisy town [[mall:mall]] or the stone shopping [[complex:complex]], home felt calm.
23.3.zh: 不像镇上吵闹的商场和石头购物中心，家里让人觉得安心。

23.4.en: They listed what they needed, skipping the distant [[supermarket:supermarket]] and the [[night:night]] market [[booth:booth]].
23.4.zh: 他们列出了要买的物品，跳过远处的超市和夜市小摊。

paraZh.12: 舞衣迷人体面精致，淡妆暖衣温柔依旧。
paraZh.13: 叠衣入柜补衣钉扣，帽檐围巾一一整好。
paraZh.14: 手帕钱包归置包礼物，领袖袜鞋各有修补。
paraZh.15: 裁缝缝边纺纱别针，绳线缎带腰带齐活。
paraZh.16: 金链珠串丝绒羊毛收尾，紫色遮痕旧物重生。
paraZh.17: 去渍护色试新衣，黄昏共茶暖意满街。
paraZh.18: 奶奶拍板新建厅堂，全家分工畅想新场地。
paraZh.19: 找图纸劝小鸟定住处，老屋满是爱不做旅舍。
paraZh.20: 清棚屋发现旧摇篮，画方格分区先扫过道。
paraZh.21: 擦柱数梁扫灰上楼，圆拱高顶夏也凉。
paraZh.22: 留壁炉弃暖气擦柜门，迎客角规划初现。
paraZh.23: 开阳台刷马桶列清单，家里安静胜过商场。
